meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 做代码审查时每条发现压成一行：位置、问题、修复办法，可用 🔴 bug、🟡 risk、🔵 nit 等前缀标严重程度。它只输出可粘贴进 PR 的评论，不改代码、不批准/拒绝合并、不跑 linter。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-review，或说“review this PR”“review the diff”等要求审查代码时触发；说“normal mode”则退回啰嗦风格。

say.note: 逐行输出发现，含位置、问题、修复

say.text: review the diff，安全类发现请用完整段落解释
say.note: 安全发现不压缩，其余保持一行一条
退回常规啰嗦的审查风格

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gives compressed code reviews: one line per finding with location, problem, fix, optionally tagged 🔴 bug/🟡 risk/🔵 nit/❓ q. Output is comments ready to paste into a PR; it does not write fixes, approve changes, or run linters.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman-review, or say "review this PR" or "review the diff". Saying "normal mode" returns to verbose review style.

say_en.note: Outputs one-line findings: location, problem, fix.

say_en.text: review the diff; use full paragraphs for security findings
say_en.note: Security notes stay verbose, the rest terse.
